subject: Media Literacy
title: State-Sponsored Troll Farms
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: State-Sponsored Troll Farms.

hook.text: In St. Petersburg, hundreds of workers post fake comments on Western websites 12 hours a day.

buildup.text: Russia's Internet Research Agency employed thousands to spread disinformation on Western social media.

discovery.text: Troll farms don't just spread one message. They amplify division by arguing all sides of an issue.

twist.text: Their goal isn't to make you believe Russia. It's to make you stop believing anything.

climax.text: When trust in all information collapses, authoritarianism becomes easier to sell.

punchline.text: Confusion is the goal, not a side effect.

quiz.question: What is the ultimate goal of state-sponsored troll farms?
options: To destroy trust in all information sources
